verdict.rationale: Pigment's finance use-case page says data is integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports, which is a first-party but thin mention of scheduled refresh. Nothing in the pack shows a per-source last-synced indicator, and no documented refresh schedule tied to the close appears. missing for 10: per-connection last-sync timestamp/status visibility, documented refresh scheduling details (cadence, post-close timing), knowledge-base docs on connector sync behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
